analysis: The gated candidate completed successfully and achieved validation HR@10=0.625, matching the reference 0.625. This attempt therefore showed no improvement in the optimization target. The host selected epoch 10 across 30 completed epochs. The result supports implementation viability, but does not establish a benefit from content-dependent gating or explain why performance tied.
code_summary: One causal NextItNet with eight residual blocks, hidden size 64, kernel size 3, and dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block retains two depthwise causal convolutions and pointwise mixers. The first mixer outputs 2H channels, split into value and gate, followed by GELU(value) * sigmoid(gate), dropout, and masking. Layer normalization, residual connections, item and position embeddings, candidate scoring, interfaces, and all eight hyperparameters remain unchanged.
